note: Adapted from the original German description of Holmgren 1913. The original reads Calotermes (Glyptotermes) ceylonicus Holmgr. (1911, 1); type locality Peradeniya, Ceylon (collected by Green). The original gives measurements for two alates (a small one and a larger one); the head width and the body length with wings of the larger specimen are damaged in the photocopy, while the soldier measurements are complete. In a note on synonymy the original withdraws its own 1911 view that these alates belonged to G. dilatatus.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier: head almost cylindrical, much longer than wide; frons strongly inclined, concave in the middle and bilobed, the sides rounded; labrum extending beyond half of the closed mandibles, longer than wide; mandibles very short and broad; antennae 12-segmented, very short, segment 3 very short. Compared with the closely related G. dilatatus, this species has the mandibles very short and very broad (in dilatatus the mandibles are relatively long and stout), the labrum extending beyond half the length of the mandibles (in dilatatus only beyond the first third of the mandibular length), and the antennae 12-segmented with segment 3 very short (dilatatus 12—13-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2). The alate has a pale T-shaped mark on the pronotum.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Yellowish brown to brown, the venter straw-yellow; wings transparent, the costal veins brown; pronotum with a pale yellow T-shaped mark. Vestiture very sparse. Head four-cornered oval, longer than wide, rather thick, slightly flattened towards the frons; sagittal suture very distinct; compound eyes small, slightly protruding; ocelli medium-sized, almost touching the compound eyes, slightly oblique; postclypeus very short; labrum small, strongly inclined; antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 about as long as segment 2 and slightly longer than segment 4. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, the anterior corners rounded at almost an acute angle, the posterior corners broadly rounded; posterior margin of the mesonotum and metanotum slightly concave; wing membrane with tubercles; subcosta of the forewing reduced, radius short, cubital mark very weak with 10—12 branches. Measurements (mm): small specimen body length with wings 8.5, body length without wings 4.7, forewing length 7.3, head length 1.37, head width 1.18, pronotal width 0.90, pronotal length 0.53; larger specimen body length without wings 6, head length 1.52, pronotal width 1.22, pronotal length 0.72 (the head width and the body length with wings of this specimen are damaged in the photocopy).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow-red, the anterior part tinged with brown; mandibles black with a brownish base; body straw-yellow. Vestiture very sparse. Head almost cylindrical, much longer than wide; frons strongly inclined, concave in the middle and bilobed, the sides rounded; postclypeus short; labrum extending beyond half of the closed mandibles, longer than wide; mandibles very short and broad; antennae 12-segmented, very short, segment 3 very short. Pronotum narrower than the head, semilunar, the anterior margin concave, the posterior margin shallowly concave in the middle; abdomen elongate and narrow. Measurements (mm): body length 6.5—7, head length with mandibles 3.31, head length without mandibles 2.6 (last digit damaged in the original), head width 1.56, pronotal width 1.33, pronotal length 0.65.
